updates.c: Amazing. Masterpiece. One of the most moving film that I’ve seen. Make you think about our social system and relationships. Ava DuVernay didn’t suck!
Superbe film à suspense qui met en tension la morale et la justice. Montgomery donne à voir une très bonne performance.
Funny time to time but definitely less than A bug’s Life

A moving romance. Sometimes could be a bit confusing when we switch between the different space-time, flashback and so. Really liked the end that isn’t so explicit but evocative and that’s more memorable.

A race movie who shows a cinema that exists in parallel of Hollywood and represent African American actors. The movie is almost too short (only 1 hour) and can’t really develop the story. It’s sad because technically the movie is really low-quality in regard of its time (looks like a 1920s movie instead of 1949). I mean, Citizen Kane by Orson Wells or Rebecca by Hitchcock were far  higher in quality one decade before. Then, we can see the big gap between Hollywood and indépendant (black) movie productions.

La mise en scène et le montage du film sont très intéressants. Chaque histoire est découpée en scène – filmée à chaque fois en “plan-séquence” (one shot). Cela demande une grande performance vis-à-vis des acteurs et actrices. Le coupage des plans est également bien choisi et percutant.
A moving film at times. Not boring but is a lil bit too long maybe to make the spectator feels like the mother: isolated, bored, alone and sad ?

Really nice shots. Nice lighting treatment. Nice landscapes. The cinematography of this movie is amazing. Most of the scenes are set during the dusk and dawn with soft colors. It matches very well with the song, giving a dreamlike atmosphere.

A Czechoslovak New Wave movie. Indeed, we can see the new wave style with the edits and artistic choices (especially the use of different monochrome). Interesting to see a movie from another country, my first Czech one. 
But I don’t really like the fact that it’s too disjointed. That gives a surrealistic style for sure. But it’s difficult to follow and be captivated.

A painful movie. We are witnessing to the cold world of prostitution with chilling scenes and the difficulty to escape. I feel empathy for the main character Mary. Furthermore, Vladimir Cosma’s music “La dérobade” is a really good underscoring.

This movie could be a great one but there were too many unnecessary scenes and sometimes too dramatic like with the bug, the dream or the faint. I still wonder about the role of « James Bond » in this movie? 🤔
Really nice shots, the lights and some set up are very beautiful. It’s a contemplative movie so it’s slow but maybe sometimes it is a bit boring and that’s why I don’t give 4 stars.
I’m not really into horror movies but this one was very interesting because there was a part of psychology in it (like a psychological thriller).
